info.title: Harvestr.io Universal API

lastDiscoverystateUpdatedAt.description: Date when the discovery state was last updated

parentId.description: Identifier of the parent (component or discovery)

updatedAt.description: Last update date of the discovery

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

labels.description: Message labels. Priority order: 1) 'set' overwrites all labels, 2) 'connect' and 'disconnect' are applied together (if a label is in both, disconnect takes precedence and it won't be connected)

labels.connect[].description: Connect a list of message labels

labels.disconnect[].description: Disconnect a list of message labels

labels.set[].description: Set and overwrite a list of message labels

inboxType.description: Message inbox type. NEW = unprocessed inbox, PROCESSED = processed inbox, BIN = archived/trash

bin.description: Whether the message is in the bin

channel.description: Channel through which the message was received

integrationId.description: When you import messages from an external source (e.g.: Intercom) into Harvestr, this is the message ID in the source tool

integrationUrl.description: When you import messages from an external source (e.g.: Intercom) into Harvestr, this is the URL of the message in the source tool

read.description: Whether the message has been read

receivedAt.description: Date when the message was received

updated.description: Whether the message has been updated

updatedAt.description: Last update date of the message
